Dear Helium D. Support Team,

I am contacting you regarding my order *Shop····* for the *Nexus S1 (10
TH/s)*.

According to the tracking information, the UPS shipping
label ···· was created on October 15,2026. However, as of
today, October 21, there has been no further tracking update, and it
appears that UPS has not yet collected the package.

Could you please confirm whether my Nexus S1 has already been physically
handed over to UPS?

If the package is still awaiting collection, I would appreciate an update
on the reason for the delay and when I can expect it to be dispatched.

Thank you in advance for your assistance. I look forward to your response.

Best regards

Marvin M.

Dear Mr M.,

Thank you for the detail, and I'm sorry you've had to ask twice.

To answer your question honestly: no, the parcel has not been physically handed over yet. Your Nexus S1 was picked and packed at our Rotterdam warehouse on October 15 and the label was created the same day, but the shipment still reads "waiting for carrier pickup" on our side and there is no carrier scan on it. That matches exactly what you're seeing in the tracking.

I can't tell you from here why the collection hasn't happened, and I won't guess at a dispatch date. Rotterdam is the only place that can answer that, so I've put this in front of the team with your order and the shipment reference. They're offline right now and pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET, which is 4pm your time, and the answer comes to you at (email hidden) You don't need to do anything or wait in a chat window.

Your tracking link stays the same: (tracking link hidden)

Best regards,
Sarah H. Support
